question: What kind of software engineering task is this request?

tasks.explain: Explain or answer a question about how existing code works, without changing it
tasks.edit: Make a small, local edit such as fixing a typo, renaming something or changing one value
tasks.chore: Run commands or routine chores such as git operations, installing dependencies, builds or formatting
tasks.feature: Implement a new feature or add new behaviour to the software
tasks.debug: Find and fix the cause of a bug, an error or a failing test
tasks.refactor: Restructure or clean up existing code without changing what it does
tasks.design: Design an architecture, plan an approach or compare technical trade-offs
tasks.review: Review code for bugs, security or performance problems

large_work: The request needs substantial work across many files or a deep investigation.
